title: Generating a Spring Boot project and its structure

objectives.text: Generate a Maven Spring Boot project with Spring Initializr, choosing the Java version, group, artifact and the web starter
Locate the main application class, application.properties, src/main and src/test, and the parent and starter dependencies in pom.xml of a generated project
Build and run the generated project's tests with Maven and start the application, then read the startup log to find the port it listens on

This worst path was modeled, not measured on these pages. budget = aboutLabel = ceil(max(P50, worst path)) under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md, within the 15 minute cap.
